title.zh: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
title.en: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes

current_state.zh: Keystone is destroying 18,835 unsold hardware wallets and has suspended shipping after an attacker obtained the permanent factory key used to verify its devices are genuine, while 25,964 customer records from its Shopify store were also exposed.
current_state.en: Keystone is destroying 18,835 unsold hardware wallets and has suspended shipping after an attacker obtained the permanent factory key used to verify its devices are genuine, while 25,964 customer records from its Shopify store were also exposed.
